correctness.rationale: Regular nilpotent J_n has a cyclic vector lifting over R, so every X is similar to multiplication by T on R[T]/(T^n-eps*g-eps²h). Characteristic polynomial first differential C→(tr(J^i C))_(i<n) is surjective by distinct lower subdiagonal sums; second coefficient is linear in D plus quadratic in C. Thus g,h are uniform independent with fiber q^(2n²-2n). Relation T^n=eps*g+eps²*h gives T^(2n)=eps²*g² and T^(3n)=0. If r=v(g)<ceil(n/2), last power gives index 3n-2r. Otherwise h'=h+g²/T^n mod T^n uniform conditional g, last power yields index 2n-min(v(g),v(h')). The valuation-tail laws of independent uniform degree<n polynomials yield full stated frequencies and exhaustive disjoint support, including n=1 and q any prime power. Independent quotient-ring enumeration for n,q=(1,2),(2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(4,2) gave exactly expected distributions, gap index 5 missing at n=2 q=2, and normalized probabilities sum1. This verifies nonstandard reduction and no global inference from finite cases.
